description: This file defines the 'ReferencedObjectCollection' class, which manages a collection of objects that are referenced during serialization, deserialization, or copying processes within the Orleans serialization framework. It includes methods for handling references, creating placeholders, and managing overflow dictionaries for large collections.

classes.name: ReferencedObjectCollection
classes.description: A sealed class managing references to objects during serialization tasks, supporting both in-array and overflow dictionary storage for object references.

methods.name: TryGetReferencedObject
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a referenced object by its reference ID.

methods.name: MarkValueField
methods.description: Marks a value field by incrementing the current reference ID.

methods.name: CreateRecordPlaceholder
methods.description: Creates a placeholder record with a new reference ID.

methods.name: GetOrAddReference
methods.description: Retrieves or adds a reference for a given object, returning whether it already existed.

methods.name: GetReferenceIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of an object in the reference table, or -1 if not found.

methods.name: CreateObjectToReferenceOverflow
methods.description: Converts the internal object-to-reference mapping to an overflow dictionary when arrays are full.

methods.name: AddToReferences
methods.description: Adds an object and its reference ID to the in-array reference list or overflow dictionary.

methods.name: ThrowReferenceExistsException
methods.description: Throws an exception if a duplicate reference is detected.

methods.name: RecordReferenceField
methods.description: Records a reference for an object, automatically assigns a new reference ID.

methods.name: RecordReferenceField with referenceId
methods.description: Records a reference for an object with a specified reference ID.

methods.name: CopyReferenceTable
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current reference-to-object mapping.

methods.name: CopyIdTable
methods.description: Creates a copy of the object-to-reference identifier mapping.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state, clearing all references and overflow dictionaries.
